legal_principles.principle: A Family Court shall have and exercise all the jurisdiction exercisable by any district Court or any subordinate civil Court under any law for the time being in force.

legal_principles.principle: Where a Family Court has been established for any area, no district Court or any subordinate civil Court shall have or exercise any jurisdiction in respect of any suit or proceeding of the nature referred to in the Explanation.
